job.title: Founding Account Executive
job.description:
About Cadmus

Cadmus is a Melbourne-founded assessment platform dedicated to transforming the university learning experience. With a team of approximately 47 people, the company provides a guided workspace where students complete assignments and exams directly within their university’s online learning system (Canvas, Moodle, Blackboard, or D2L). By providing staff with real-time visibility into student progress, Cadmus enables earlier intervention, leading to higher pass rates and a significant reduction in academic misconduct.


As higher education navigates the challenges of AI, Cadmus offers a robust solution for authentic assessment, delivering an estimated 7.1x ROI according to Nous Group. Already trusted by institutions like Manchester, King’s College London, and Exeter, Cadmus is rapidly scaling across the UK, Europe, the Middle East, and the US. Notably, Cadmus secured first place on the APUC framework in November 2025, providing a simplified procurement route for UK universities.


About the job

As the Founding Account Executive for the UK, you will be the first dedicated salesperson on the ground in the region. This is a high-impact, consultative role focused on winning university pilots and converting them into long-term institutional contracts across EMEA, with a primary focus on the UK market.


Reporting directly to the Chief Revenue Officer and working closely with the CEO, you will be responsible for building the sales motion from the ground up. This is not a high-volume, "salesy" environment; it is a sophisticated, relationship-driven market where you will engage with highly educated academics and senior university leaders. You will join a London-based team that includes Partner Success Managers and Learning Support Managers, ensuring you have the academic and technical expertise behind you to close complex deals.


What you'll do

  • Identify and nurture high-value relationships within a defined market of approximately 500 key university stakeholders across the UK and EMEA.
  • Lead the end-to-end sales cycle for complex, multi-stakeholder deals, from initial outreach and relationship building to winning the pilot phase.
  • Collaborate with the CEO and CRO at key moments of the sale to provide executive alignment and close strategic accounts.
  • Manage the commercial transition of university pilots, working alongside the Customer Success team to ensure successful conversion into long-term contracts.
  • Execute a consultative sales strategy that prioritizes referrals and direct outreach over traditional cold-calling or SDR-led models.
  • Drive expansion within existing accounts by identifying opportunities for upselling and broader institutional adoption.
  • Utilize modern research tools and platforms to identify ideal customer profiles and tailor outreach to the specific needs of higher education leaders.

What we're looking for

We are looking for a genuinely intelligent, consultative seller who can hold their own in sophisticated conversations with academics and senior university leaders.


  • 4–6+ years of experience in B2B sales, specifically operating as a mid-level to senior Account Executive.
  • Proven track record in consultative selling, with experience managing long-cycle, complex SaaS deals involving multiple stakeholders.
  • High intellectual curiosity and the ability to build credibility quickly with sophisticated, highly educated buyers.
  • Independence and drive to build a sales motion from scratch without reliance on SDRs or high-volume cold-calling.
  • Exceptional communication skills, with a style that is professional and helpful rather than pushy or transactional.
  • Nice to have: Direct experience selling to universities or the broader public sector.
  • A plus: A background in professional consulting at the start of your career.
  • Nice to have: Experience within the Higher Education or EdTech sector.

Why join Cadmus

  • Founding Impact: As the first AE in the UK, you will have a direct hand in shaping the company’s regional strategy and sales culture.
  • Global Growth: Cadmus is expanding rapidly; this role offers a clear path for ambitious individuals to potentially move into leadership roles in the US or Middle East (Dubai) as the company grows.
  • Mission-Driven Work: Play a central role in helping universities solve the most pressing challenges in modern education, from AI integration to student retention.
  • Direct Access: Work daily with the founding executive team, including the CEO and CRO, providing a unique opportunity for professional development and visibility.
  • Flexible Working: Enjoy a hybrid work model based in London that balances office collaboration, home working, and face-to-face client visits without rigid set office days.

job.title: Strategy & Partnership Success Lead
job.description:
About Cadmus

Cadmus is an assessment platform for universities designed to improve student success and academic integrity. Founded in Melbourne and now scaling across the UK, Europe, the Middle East, and the US, Cadmus provides a guided workspace where students complete assignments and exams directly within their university’s online learning system (such as Canvas, Moodle, or Blackboard).

By providing real-time visibility into the learning process, Cadmus allows teaching staff to intervene early, resulting in better pass rates and a significant reduction in academic misconduct. In an era where generative AI is reshaping education, Cadmus ensures that assessment remains authentic and impactful. Our partners include leading UK institutions such as King’s College London, the University of Manchester, and the University of Exeter.

About the job

The Strategy & Partnership Success Lead is a critical role that sits at the intersection of executive leadership and our frontline delivery teams. Reporting directly to the CEO and the Chief Revenue Officer, you will act as a strategic extension of the leadership team, owning the long-term roadmap for every UK partner university.

This is a client-facing position that prioritizes high-level relationship management and strategic planning. You will be the "ears on the ground" for our leadership, managing the middle layer of university partnerships: the academics and central learning teams who are both our primary users and key influencers. While you will work closely with Customer Success and Learning Support Managers as a senior peer, your focus is not on day-to-day support, but on the strategic health and expansion of our most important institutional accounts.

What you'll do

  • Own the long-term strategic plan for all existing UK partner universities, ensuring each institution is on track to meet its success and retention goals.
  • Lead "Level 2" partner conversations, running QBR-style insight meetings with academics and central learning teams to discuss pedagogical trends and product impact.
  • Support the CEO and CRO in "Level 1" meetings with university budget holders and senior economic decision-makers, providing the ground-level data they need to drive renewals.
  • Synthesize feedback from the learning team and platform analytics to identify new growth opportunities within existing accounts.
  • Act as a strategic project lead, ensuring internal teams are aligned with the long-term milestones of each partner university.
  • Monitor account health and academic engagement, maintaining high quality standards and resilience when navigating complex institutional challenges.

What we're looking for

We are looking for a smart, consulting-minded professional with the presence and credibility to own a room of senior academics.

  • 3 to 5 years of experience in strategy consulting, account direction, or a high-level strategic partnership role.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage complex, long-term projects while maintaining a primary focus on client relationship health.
  • Strong presence and credibility when speaking with academic professionals and senior university leadership.
  • Experience using data and analytics to inform account growth strategies and executive-level briefings.
  • Resilience and the ability to thrive in a high-standards environment working directly with founding leadership.
  • A plus: Professional experience within the Higher Education sector or EdTech industry.
  • Nice to have: Experience working within a scaling startup or a boutique consultancy.

Why join Cadmus

  • Executive Impact: Work as a direct extension of the CEO and CRO, gaining deep exposure to the strategic scaling of a global EdTech business.
  • Mission-Driven Work: Play a pivotal role in protecting academic integrity and improving student outcomes at some of the world's most prestigious universities.
  • Global Growth: Join a team currently expanding across the US, Middle East, and Europe, with potential opportunities to take on international scope as the account grows.
  • Autonomy and Ownership: Own the strategic direction of the entire UK partner portfolio, moving beyond day-to-day support to drive true institutional change.
  • Collaborative Culture: Work alongside a dedicated team of 47 specialists globally, supported by a hybrid London-based team that values expertise and clear communication.

job.title: Customer Support
job.description:
About Lamex Foods Group

Lamex Foods Group is one of the world's largest privately owned frozen and chilled food importers and exporters. With over 45 years of history and an annual revenue of $2 billion, the Lamex network spans 23 offices across 21 countries. The Lamex Foods Inc. division stands as the group's largest entity, facilitating sales to more than 100 countries worldwide. Driven by a global trading philosophy, the company leverages its scale and expertise to connect suppliers and customers across complex international markets, ensuring high-quality food products reach their destinations efficiently.

About the job

As a Logistics & Documentation Customer Support Representative, you will play a critical role in managing export shipments specifically destined for Colombia. Situated within the Supply Chain department, this part-time, remote position focuses on bridging the gap between traders, suppliers, customers, customs agents, and logistics partners. You will be responsible for the end-to-end coordination of export documentation, ensuring that all regulatory requirements are met and that shipments are delivered within strict deadlines. Your work ensures that Colombian customers receive comprehensive support and that cargo moves smoothly through the complexities of international trade and local customs.

What you'll do

  • Prepare, verify, and confirm export documents, ensuring all data matches cargo information, health certificate descriptions, and labeling requirements.
  • Monitor container deliveries and proactively communicate with customers and transportation providers regarding any potential delays.
  • Generate and dispatch invoices and essential export documents to customers and banks via email and physical courier services.
  • Review and approve invoices related to export documentation, including ocean shipping line fees and associated logistics costs.
  • Resolve issues related to shipment information and documentation required for Customs clearance and cargo release in Colombia.
  • Manage and issue Free Trade Agreement Certificates of Origin while maintaining organized virtual records in compliance with data retention rules.
  • Maintain daily correspondence via email and phone to solve problems and support continuous business operations.

What we're looking for

Lamex is looking for a detail-oriented logistics professional who is deeply familiar with the regulatory landscape of Colombian imports.

  • 1 to 3 years of relevant work experience specifically handling documentation for Colombian imports.
  • Professional fluency in both Spanish and English (written and verbal).
  • Proven knowledge of Colombian import customs and food safety regulations, specifically regarding meat importation (INVIMA, ICA, DIAN).
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, with a focus on Excel and Word.
  • Demonstrated problem-solving and critical-thinking skills to navigate supply chain disruptions.
  • Strong organizational skills and a high level of attention to detail regarding legal and shipping documentation.
  • A Bachelor’s Degree in a related field is preferred.
  • Experience within the food industry is a plus.

Why join Lamex Foods Group

  • Become part of a globally recognized leader in the food industry with a stable, 45-year history of success.
  • Work in a diverse and inclusive environment where team members are empowered to take ownership of their roles.
  • Contribute to a culture that welcomes creativity and innovation to solve complex global logistics challenges.
  • Join a company that highly values internal relationships and fosters a supportive, collaborative workplace.
  • Experience the flexibility of a remote role focused on high-impact logistics and customer support for a specific, vital market.

job.title: Head of Marketing
job.description:
Head of Marketing

About Partnership Leaders

Partnership Leaders is the modern advisory firm for partnerships. We help enterprise technology companies build high-performing partnership organizations that drive revenue, accelerate growth, and create competitive advantage.

The Role

We're looking for a hands-on, AI-native marketing leader who takes ownership, thinks independently, and delivers results.

Your primary goal is to generate qualified enterprise pipeline for our advisory and consulting business.

You'll lead a team of three, own our marketing strategy and execution, and work closely with sales and company leadership to grow the business.

You'll report directly to the CEO and be part of the management team.


What You'll Own

  • Demand Generation: Build and execute campaigns that generate qualified pipeline from enterprise technology companies, primarily US-based businesses with over $1B in revenue.
  • Sales Alignment: Partner with sales to identify target accounts, engage executive buyers, and create qualified opportunities.
  • Brand and Digital: Own our market positioning, thought leadership, website, social media, and digital marketing strategy.
  • Executive Engagement: Work with our analysts and leadership team to turn research and market insights into compelling content, executive conversations, and marketing campaigns.
  • AI-Enabled Marketing: Build AI into marketing workflows to improve execution, automate repetitive work, and help the team operate more effectively without compromising quality or credibility.
  • Events and Memberships: Drive Catalyst ticket sales and membership growth as secondary commercial priorities.
  • Marketing Operations: Own marketing performance, systems, processes, and budget planning.
  • Team Leadership: Lead and develop our marketing team, manage agencies, and ensure strong execution.


What We're Looking For

  • High Ownership and Agency: You take initiative, solve problems independently, make decisions, and take accountability for results. You don't wait to be told what to do.
  • Confidence to Speak Up: You challenge assumptions, share your perspective, and are comfortable disagreeing with senior leaders, including the CEO. You debate constructively and commit to decisions.
  • Proven Demand Generation: You have a track record of generating qualified pipeline for complex, high-value B2B offerings.
  • AI-Native Mindset: You actively use AI to improve how you think, work, and execute. You know how to apply AI to marketing strategy, research, campaigns, and operations, and can help your team adopt AI to improve productivity, quality, and results.
  • Executive Presence: You can engage credibly with C-level executives, develop informed perspectives, and communicate with authority and warmth.
  • Intellectual Curiosity: You enjoy learning, asking challenging questions, and turning research and market insights into ideas that resonate with executive audiences.
  • Strategic and Hands-On: You can develop a strategy, prioritize initiatives, and roll up your sleeves to execute.
  • Sales and People Leadership: You know how to work with sales teams, coach employees, manage agencies, and hold people accountable.

Preferred: Experience marketing advisory, consulting, research, or professional services. Familiarity with enterprise technology partnerships and HubSpot is a plus.


You'll Thrive Here If You

  • Enjoy building, not just maintaining, a marketing function.
  • Take responsibility for outcomes, not just activities.
  • Move quickly, make decisions, and follow through.
  • Speak your mind, welcome debate, and challenge the status quo.
  • Naturally look for ways to use AI to work smarter and improve results.
  • Enjoy engaging with senior executives and developing your own perspective on the industry.
  • Want to build your own market presence and reputation as a thought leader.


How Success Is Measured

Primary: Qualified pipeline generated for advisory and consulting services.

Secondary: Catalyst ticket sales, membership growth, and overall marketing effectiveness.

job.title: Head of Sales - NORAM
job.description:
About Cadmus

Cadmus is an education technology company dedicated to improving learning outcomes for students globally. The company provides a collaborative environment designed to uphold academic integrity while supporting the assessment journey for both educators and learners. By partnering with universities and higher education institutions, Cadmus helps academic leaders transition to more authentic, secure, and engaging assessment practices through its purpose-built platform.

About the job

As the Noram Head of Sales, you will be the primary driver for expanding the reach of the Cadmus platform across the North American market. This is a remote role at the head of sales focused on the United States and Canada. You will be responsible for the full sales cycle, from identifying high-potential institutional partners to closing complex enterprise agreements. You will navigate the unique procurement cycles and stakeholder dynamics of higher education to ensure a seamless transition from initial interest to long-term institutional partnership.

What you'll do

  • Develop and execute strategic territory plans to identify and engage target higher education institutions across the US and Canada.
  • Lead the end-to-end sales process, including initial outreach, platform demonstrations, and navigating complex institutional procurement.
  • Build and maintain deep relationships with senior academic stakeholders, including Provosts, Deans, and Heads of Learning and Teaching.
  • Negotiate and close high-value enterprise contracts that align with the platform’s value proposition and institutional goals.
  • Collaborate with marketing and product teams to refine messaging based on feedback from the North American market.
  • Maintain accurate sales forecasts and pipeline data within the CRM to ensure visibility into territory performance.

What we're looking for

We are looking for an experienced sales professional who possesses a deep understanding of the higher education landscape and a track record of selling complex software solutions to academic institutions.

  • 7-10 years of experience in enterprise sales, specifically within the higher education sector.
  • Proven mastery of full-cycle sales and navigating complex, multi-stakeholder institutional procurement processes.
  • Professional presence and credibility when presenting to academic leaders and senior university administrators.
  • Experience managing large-scale territories and working independently across North American time zones.
  • A data-driven approach to strategic forecasting and pipeline management.
  • Nice to have: Experience with Salesforce or CRM management and territory planning.
  • Nice to have: Previous experience working within a high-growth startup environment.
  • A plus: Familiarity with academic integrity standards, assessment pedagogy, and conducting platform demonstrations.

Why join Cadmus

  • Directly impact the quality of global higher education by helping institutions adopt more authentic and secure assessment methods.
  • Work with a mission-driven team that values academic excellence and student success above all else.
  • Enjoy a high degree of autonomy and ownership over the North American market in a fully remote environment.
  • Collaborate with a group of passionate educators and technologists dedicated to solving one of the most significant challenges in modern academia.

job.title: Customer Success Manager
job.description:
About Cadmus

Cadmus is a Melbourne-founded education technology company established in 2015 that provides a secure, end-to-end platform for university assessments. The platform supports assignments, exams, group work, and learning analytics, integrating directly with major Learning Management Systems like Canvas, Moodle, Blackboard, and D2L Brightspace.

By focusing on guiding students through the learning process rather than policing them, Cadmus enhances academic integrity and student outcomes in the age of AI. Currently live in Australia and the UK, Cadmus is backed by SEEK Investments and Glitch Capital following a September 2025 funding round specifically aimed at North American expansion. Independent studies have shown that universities using the platform see an average 7.1x return on investment.

About the job

As the Customer Success Manager for North America, you will be the company’s first person on the ground in the region. This is a senior, high-impact role focused on guiding new universities through critical 6-month pilots, ensuring they successfully transition from initial integration to long-term partnerships.

This is a remote position based in Canada (with a preference for Toronto) or the United States, operating at a Senior Specialist level. Because the core team is located in London, you will spend several hours each day working independently across time zones. You will be the face of Cadmus for academics and university leaders, providing high-touch support to ensure the platform is adopted effectively. As the inaugural hire in the region, you will have the opportunity to shape the customer success strategy for North America and potentially build out the local team as the business scales.

What you'll do

  • Own the end-to-end pilot lifecycle for North American universities, navigating them from initial LMS integration to successful long-term partnership.
  • Provide high-touch support to faculty and university leaders during the 6-month pilot phase to ensure deep platform engagement.
  • Lead the onboarding and training process for new faculty members, assisting them in the redesign of assessments within the Cadmus platform.
  • Act as the primary point of contact for academic stakeholders, maintaining credibility when discussing learning outcomes and academic integrity.
  • Monitor pilot health and usage data to proactively address risks and ensure high conversion rates.
  • Collaborate asynchronously with the London-based team to share regional insights and product feedback.
  • Drive customer satisfaction in the North American time zone as a self-starting regional lead, making autonomous decisions to support client needs.

What we're looking for

We are looking for an educator who became client-facing, prioritizing a strong learning background alongside customer success expertise.

  • 7 to 10 years of professional experience in customer success, account management, or client-facing roles.
  • Professional experience within Higher Education or Learning and Development (L&D).
  • Proven experience managing client-facing pilots, onboarding programs, or complex implementations.
  • Presence and credibility when working directly with academics and senior university administrators.
  • Comfortable working on your own across time zones and managing a remote territory independently.
  • A plus: Experience in EdTech SaaS or working with Learning Management Systems (Canvas, Moodle, Blackboard, or D2L Brightspace).
  • Nice to have: A background in Learning Design, Assessment Redesign, or Higher Education teaching.
  • Nice to have: Strategic account planning skills and the ambition to eventually lead or build a regional team.

Why join Cadmus

  • Foundational Regional Impact: Play a pivotal role as the first hire in North America, directly influencing how Cadmus expands across the continent.
  • Mission-Driven Innovation: Help universities navigate the challenges of AI by shifting the focus from policing to improving the student learning process.
  • Autonomy and Growth: Work with a high degree of independence and gain the long-term potential to move into leadership as the regional team grows.
  • Proven Stability: Join a company with a verified 7.1x ROI for customers and strong backing from investors like SEEK Investments and Glitch Capital.
  • Flexible Work Culture: Thrive in a fully remote environment that values outcomes, self-motivation, and inclusive professional collaboration.
